name: B10-0207/2024 (ECR) – The increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to impose more sanctions on Iran over its treatment of women. It asks the Council to extend sanctions to officials responsible for human rights abuses and to consider listing Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation. It also calls for an end to Iran's mandatory hijab laws and condemns executions. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks for wider EU sanctions on Iranian officials and the Revolutionary Guard.
- The measures would target those responsible for repressing women in Iran.
- The Council and EU foreign policy chief must now decide whether to act.
